## W20 Change and reauthorization record

W20   Workflow ID __________   Version/date __________   Status __________

Prepared by __________   Accountable owner __________   Evidence location __________

Done when: old and new versions are recorded; the affected records are revisited; the required tests are run with a reviewer separate from the proposer; and a bounded decision is signed with its W10 reference.

Source basis: [GRC Workbook](https://github.com/rolldabones/grc-workbook) · [AI Impact Assessment Tool](https://github.com/rolldabones/AI-Impact-Assessment-Tool) · [AI GRC Copilot](https://github.com/rolldabones/AI-GRC-Copilot)

**Proposed or detected change**

Purpose, data class, users, model/provider, configuration, prompt, integration, permissions or decision authority; old and new versions.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Impact and affected records**

Revisit risks, DoD, tool registry, legal applicability, staffing, evaluation, monitoring and fallback. Identify scope that must pause.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Detection and vendor dependency**

How was change detected? What notification is contractually or technically supported? Record limits where model changes cannot be frozen or fully observed.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Tests and independent review required**

Evidence before expansion; regression/edge/control tests; competency reassessment; reviewer separate from tier-up proposal.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Decision and bounded authorization**

Approve specified change, reject, defer or retract. Record residual risk, conditions, owner, deadline, effective date and next review.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

Approver/date __________  Independent reviewer/date __________  W10 reference __________

No silent increase in operating tier or workflow scope. Retraction requires a named decision-maker and a practical path to a lower tier, manual work or shutdown.
